book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Wamogpa Abram nenekori haing uamna kwelekamna senenag agha uro yabinepne kemelamogpa Nuni Allahri Abramag yubu lelamogti, “Abram, log sembaheng kom! 'Malinge anag taleag,' aro Nari an piangkeneri kamna nubunge tatkinun,” seog.

Wene seogpa Abramdi yubu lelamogti, “Nani Allah sa'a aba agha Andi na tatnululam, Nani na me nhon tatneom komba na me koma tebaneba naringe sae agha nari arukna Eliezer Damsyikne ponekoag talul,” seog.
Wene seogpa Allahri yubu lelamogti, “Nimi etneag babe andinge sae agha elag talul kom. Ot andi me taptopneag andinge sae agha elag talul,” seogti
Abram enero asag poa lambaogti ambarelamogti, “Imag tiwalengkipmendi imberea tiwalengkiplulam! Imberea a'ilbanep kom wamla saog uro andi mangarobari mangkahyikne taneko maikno taukang,” seog.
Allahri lebogne nene sembe Abramdi, “Ot sik uro lepla,” aro seneraglamogpa, Nuni Allahri Abramag wana piamog.
Kwelekaogpa, nen Abramag Allahri yubu lelamogti, “Na Nani Allah wamna. 'So'o ane an ngai talulam,' aro Nari Ur-Kasdim so'oag agha enero payaghai,” seog.
Wene seogpa Abramdi Allahag hailamogti, “Nani Allah nubunge, Andi, 'Mog so'o ane tatkinun,' selam aghana, kekneba uamenba 'Sik uro lepla,' sembanun,” aro haibaog.
Haibaogpa Nuni Allahri, “Pham sapi kelne nhon, kambing kelne nhon, domba yemne nhon heng kun wilindi ubu piamangneap winang mem winang ologne nhon, nubunge nhon tarel anululam,” seog.
“Tarel anululam,” seogpa payaogti pham taneko usoghag agha amuag serelingkiogti lelero palilamogti winang abeneko ningki oro pibog.
Pibogti wamogpa winang pham kalerop winang yingkina tukap aro ulamekpa Abramdi yaglamsiog.
Heng purukanep peram ulamogpa Abram kwhaingti mangkhauk mabog abeneko inipna tuka'ag aropne logne niknilaog.
Tuka'ag seog abeneko Allah yubu lelamogti, “El uro wamlulam, andi mangarobari mangkahyikne taneko heng kun teng naual tarabare
ane ni wamikpa nimiri asag agha sekelanan nimi aro arukna maikno aruklamsiikti olamsukang.
An anisag yabo arukna nembamsiikti olamsiik nimi taneko sindi ulamikne sembe Nari lumbahineba anisag yabo lanalamikti nia mangkina poro agha lambaukang.
An aghabogna anenge nimi sisa likna pimenba, hong kul wangkeleba, wana aingniro tebamenba, so'oag sikkukang.
Aghana nimi sisa andinge nimi likna tomne neneko samoro ane yaukang. Amori nimi mog so'o ngai nimi yonge aghabog ulamangne Na wana sesog wamnel kom. Wana sesog uanele sum lumbanun,” seog.
Heng purukaogti imbaogpa Abramdi kemelamogpa auk una-ap whea-ap pham kalero phendeag piroba anabiag auk una mhong yarut alamogpa whea auk pog tagtag alamogpa yabalamog.

Undo unulamog abeneko Allahri sumene Abramag salag lelamogti, “Andi mabo mangaroba-ag mog so'o nene anag Mesira yalamlari mag nubunge Efrat neneag. Keni nimiri so'oap, Kenas nimiri so'oap, Kadmon nimiri so'oap, Het nimiri so'oap, Feris nimiri so'oap, Rafaim nimiri so'oap, Amori nimiri so'oap, Kanaan nimiri so'oap, Girgasi nimiri so'oap, Yebus nimiri so'oap andi mangaroba-ag tatsinun,” seog.

footnotes.text: Samenag yubuag, “Heng kun teng mekpare eptopne no'op tarabare (400)” mome torop.
-21 As si lebapneap nimi sisaap sembe Allahri, “Mog so'o teroba orog nembahineri Abram eldi mangaroba-ag tatsinun,” aro lebog.
